text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#54321 - proxy-request-latency spike in eu-west-1. Triggered at 2026-03-15T09:17:36Z. Affected service: inference-proxy. Auto-escalation window: 5m.

jordan: on it, grabbing metrics.

chris: saw the metric on the dashboard too, small bump but noisy. pinging logs.

maya: @jordan if it's quick/no-customer-impact we should let PD auto-resolve unless it stays >5m.

jordan: ack. running quick query: `curl -s \"https://metrics.redwood.internal/api/series?metric=proxy_p95_latency&region=eu-west-1&lookback=15m\" | jq .`

jordan: output shows a ~400ms 1-min spike at ~09:16 that decayed by 09:18. baseline ~120ms.

incident-bot: PD note: alert condition cleared at 2026-03-15T09:18:12Z (auto-resolve).

chris: looks like auto-resolved. I'm going to sample the request logs for that window: `kubectl logs deployment/proxy -n prod --since=5m | grep \"latency_ms\" | head -30`

jordan: found a small batch of timeouts to a third-party tokenizer service around 09:16-09:17, likely transient. 4 requests timed out, all retried successfully.

maya: any customer impact?

chris: quick check on error budget and customer traces: no SLO breaches, no user-facing errors in the last hour. Traces show 2 requests retried with slightly higher latency but completed.

jordan: adding note to the incident thread: probable cause = transient tokenizer downstream latency. severity = minor, customer impact = none.

maya: cool. since PD auto-resolved and no impact, I'm going to mark this as no followup needed. leaving a short playbook note: check third-party latency, add circuit-breaker if repeats.

pagerduty: Note: incident was auto-acknowledged by responder policy (on-call).

chris: re: runbook, adding a quick snippet to ops-runbook: `if transient downstream latency < 10m and no errors -> no action; if >10m escalate and open incident.`

jordan: added the runbook line and a Grafana alert refinement JIRA: INFRA-2248 to reduce sensitivity for short blips.

maya: handing off to next on-call with context: brief spike from downstream tokenizer at 09:16, auto-resolved, no customer impact, JIRA INFRA-2248 created. @oncall-next please watch eu-west-1 proxy_p95 for the next 24h. :point_up:

jordan: thanks, handoff ack.

incident-bot: Thread closed (auto-resolve recorded).

maya: thumbs up. marking as CLOSED in the channel. :white_check_mark:

chris: FYI I pulled a tiny sample of the 4 requests and saved to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incident-samples/4789123456/sample-090616.json

jordan: nice. if it reappears we'll reopen PD with higher severity. for now moving to quiet ops queue.

maya: tl;dr: noisy short latency spike -> PD auto-resolved -> no customer impact -> runbook tweak ticket created -> monitoring watch for 24h.
